additionalObservations: Both success and failure publication retain document owner, presentation UUID, request UUID, mounted-owner, current-modal and cancellation fences. An old defer cannot finish a newer request.

Closing Properties, actual unmount/revoke and a new mounted owner retire the old model state; cancelled owned tasks join the existing closingObservers drain. No new native session, write or process manager is introduced.

The original navigation/dismissal implementation (requestOpenObject, ownedPresentationDidDismiss, continueNavigation) is byte-identical; View callback changes are limited to reservation/source-sheet generation custody.

The new four-method/nine-declared-case suite retains bounded rendezvous waits and deferred continuation cleanup. Await-helper cases verify join versus early return and cancellation forwarding in both modes; retained-reservation assertions explicitly avoid assuming SwiftUI destroys State.

resolvedBoundaries.detail: The exact public async showDocuments(with:) signature is retained. A pre-cancelled caller is rejected before starting work; the separate synchronous requestSourceDocuments tap entry captures request ownership before Task creation. The async wrapper awaits the same returned task through withTaskCancellationHandler; onCancel cancels that exact task. A noncooperative provider remains joined rather than reporting early completion.

The model exposes an observable presentationID renewed on beginPresentation and cleared on retirement. The View reservation stores this same ID; a retained reservation from a closed sheet is not reserved in the new generation. Release requires expected==current and matching stored ID. Related completion, synchronous failure release, all dismissal release callbacks, and source-sheet Binding/Done captures carry generation. onDisappear retires local reservation only when Properties itself is closed, preserving the original child-sheet policy.

supersededScope: Root predecessor findings on public async API semantics and retained View reservation; all original review-v1 bytes and findings remain retained.

testScope.coverageLimit: Regression source exercises the production result model, reservation value and async wait helper; actual AnyDocumentPresentation/native wiring and SwiftUI sheet lifecycle remain source-reviewed only until compiled and exercised.
